title: Branch-specific airway consequence videos (3 × 45s)
sharedRules: Include observable changes, team communication, Rohan access status, one remaining uncertainty
Captions + audio description + reduced-sensory text timeline

branchA.title: Early bronchoscopy
branchA.summary: Early bronchoscopy removes a distal plug. Brief hypotension. No arrest.

transcript.speaker: AD
transcript.text: Controlled bronchoscopy implied without graphic footage. Pressure trend begins to fall.

transcript.speaker: Clinician
transcript.text: Plug coming out in sections. Right chest moving better.

transcript.speaker: Clinician
transcript.text: Blood pressure dipping — brief. No arrest. Fluids and position as planned.

transcript.speaker: AD
transcript.text: Rohan’s auditory scanning stays available. Samira watches; does not answer for him.

transcript.speaker: Clinician
transcript.text: Rohan — access stays on. We still do not know if secretions will rebuild overnight.

transcript.speaker: ONSCREEN
transcript.text: Next: sedation reduction and communication restoration.

captions: Clinician: Plug coming out in sections. Right chest moving better.
Clinician: Blood pressure dipping — brief. No arrest.
Clinician: Rohan — access stays on. We still do not know if secretions will rebuild overnight.
branchA.audioDescription: Pressures fall after clearance; brief hypotension without arrest; scanning access maintained; uncertainty about overnight reaccumulation; transition card.
branchA.reducedSensoryAlt: Text timeline: clearance → brief BP dip → access on → uncertainty → next decision.
branchA.uncertaintyRemaining: Whether inflammation will re-accumulate secretions overnight.

branchB.title: Targeted clearance and observation
branchB.summary: Partial pressure improvement; obstruction remains uncertain; later worsening risk.

transcript.speaker: AD
transcript.text: Humidification and positioning. Pressures ease modestly — not to baseline.

transcript.speaker: Clinician
transcript.text: Better than before. Not equal. We have not ruled out a distal plug.

transcript.speaker: AD
transcript.text: Cheek switch active. Reassessment clock set on the whiteboard.

transcript.speaker: Clinician
transcript.text: Rohan — we will check again early. Tell us if RIGHT MIDDLE changes.

transcript.speaker: AD
transcript.text: Later same shift cue: pressures beginning to climb again — cut before full crisis.

transcript.speaker: ONSCREEN
transcript.text: Next: sedation reduction and communication restoration.

captions: Clinician: Better than before. Not equal. We have not ruled out a distal plug.
Clinician: Rohan — we will check again early. Tell us if RIGHT MIDDLE changes.
branchB.audioDescription: Partial improvement; unresolved differential; access on; later climb cue; transition card. No praise language.
branchB.reducedSensoryAlt: Text timeline: partial ease → uncertainty → reassessment clock → later climb → next decision.
branchB.uncertaintyRemaining: Whether a plug will declare itself after hours of observation.

branchC.title: Aggressive pressure recruitment
branchC.summary: Brief aeration gain; ventricular instability; concern for pressure-related lung injury.

transcript.speaker: AD
transcript.text: Recruitment manoeuvre. Right chest rises briefly.

transcript.speaker: Clinician
transcript.text: Aeration better for a moment — watch the rhythm.

transcript.speaker: AD
transcript.text: Ectopy clusters. ICD pacing cue on the monitor — no flashing strobe.

transcript.speaker: Clinician
transcript.text: Backing off recruitment. Treating the respiratory trigger. Escalation remains available.

transcript.speaker: Clinician
transcript.text: Rohan — access flickered with fatigue. Partner-assisted scan is back. This is fatigue, not a capacity judgement.

transcript.speaker: Clinician
transcript.text: We remain uncertain about pressure-related lung injury versus residual obstruction.

transcript.speaker: ONSCREEN
transcript.text: Next: sedation reduction and communication restoration.

branchC.audioDescription: Brief aeration; ectopy and ICD pacing without spectacle; access restored after fatigue; dual uncertainty named; transition card.
branchC.reducedSensoryAlt: Text timeline with visual rhythm banner instead of alarm audio; next decision card.
branchC.uncertaintyRemaining: Pressure-related lung injury contribution versus residual plug.
